summary: Iteration 72 — Full backend + frontend testing of the Orisei Truck Cleaning business module (Doc Vault, Onboarding lifecycle, Invoicing, public Stripe pay page). Backend: 31/31 pytest tests pass (vault upload/list/filter/download/delete, onboarding create→submit→approve/reject with plan rates one_time=150 / biweekly_sub=120 / fleet_sub=125, welcome packet PDF, invoice create with custom items, PDFs, mark-paid + job cascade, Stripe test-mode checkout cs_test_ URL, checkout after paid returns 400, Resend intentionally returns 400 with helpful message). Frontend: admin /truck-cleaning renders all 9 tabs and tc-logo, Onboarding creates invite + shows link/PACKET/APPROVE actions, public /tc/onboard/{token} 3-step wizard submits and shows tcp-done, Invoices tab creates invoice with custom line item, email dialog opens and shows Resend-not-configured toast, mark paid flips row status to 'paid', Doc Vault upload + category filter + delete all work, public /tc/invoice/{id} renders tci-invoice-card / logo / total / status / pdf-link, PAY button redirects to real checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_... (verified redirect, did NOT complete payment), paid invoice shows tci-paid-banner and hides pay button.

issues: Console shows recurring 401 errors from unrelated background pollers (looks like QuickBooks OAuth / Sentinel polling with wrong token). Not blocking this feature but should be triaged — clutters the console for public /tc/* pages too where no admin session should be needed.

action_items: No blocking issues. Optional: investigate background 401 polling that fires on public /tc/onboard/{token} and /tc/invoice/{id} pages (should skip if no session token present) to keep public browser consoles clean.
critical_code_review_comments: truck_cleaning_biz.py public pay endpoint GET /pay/{invoice_id} correctly whitelists fields (no stripe_session_id leaked) — good.
email invoice endpoint returns 400 with actionable Resend message when Connections not configured — well handled.
checkout endpoint gracefully falls back when managed_payments unsupported (try/except InvalidRequestError) — good defensive coding.
vault delete does not require a category/client match — anyone with admin token can delete anything, which is expected for admin, but consider audit-logging deletes.
reject onboarding requires status='submitted' — matches spec. approve enforces same. Good state-machine discipline.
PLAN_RATES hard-coded (150/120/125) — consider moving to config or DB for future pricing changes.
test_credentials: Admin bearer test_session_admin_1; frontend localStorage tms_session_token=test_session_admin_1. Public /tc/* pages need NO auth.
